seoTitle: PDF Signer: Draw or Type a Signature and Place It
metaDescription: Draw, type or upload a signature, place it on a PDF page with a live preview and save the signed copy. Image signature only, runs in your browser.
intro: Create a signature by drawing with a mouse, pen or finger, by typing your name in a script style, or from an image. Place it on a page with a preview and save a signed PDF.
why:
Many forms only need a visible signature, and printing, signing and scanning is slow. This tool puts a picture of your signature on the page and lets you position it by clicking the preview or by typing numbers, so it also works with a keyboard.

Be clear about what it is: an image on the page, not a cryptographic digital signature, and it proves nothing by itself. Some contracts and authorities require a qualified electronic signature instead. The file is rewritten, so form fields and bookmarks are dropped; fill the form first. Nothing leaves your browser, and the drawing is cropped to your ink.
howTo: Choose a PDF and pick the page.
Draw on the pad, or type a name and press "Use the typed name", or load a signature image.
Click the preview to place it, or type the position and width.

faq.q: Is this a legally valid signature?
faq.a: It depends on the document and the country. It is a visible signature image, not a certificate-based digital signature. Check what the recipient requires.

faq.q: Can I use it without a mouse?
faq.a: Yes. Type your name, choose a style, and enter the position as numbers.
